crossRefs.note: He who tills his land shall have plenty of bread, but he who chases fantasies is void of understanding.
Where no oxen are, the crib is clean, but much increase is by the strength of the ox.
Know well the state of your flocks, and pay attention to your herds:
One who walks with wise men grows wise, but a companion of fools suffers harm.
Don’t be among ones drinking too much wine, or those who gorge themselves on meat:
for the drunkard and the glutton shall become poor; and drowsiness clothes them in rags.
They gave him seventy pieces of silver out of the house of Baal Berith, with which Abimelech hired vain and reckless…
The younger of them said to his father, ‘Father, give me my share of your property.’ He divided his livelihood between…

translations.web: One who works his land will have an abundance of food; but one who chases fantasies will have his fill of poverty.
translations.bsb: The one who works his land will have plenty of food, but whoever chases fantasies will have his fill of poverty.
translations.kjv: He that tilleth his land shall have plenty of bread: but he that followeth after vain persons shall have poverty enough.
translations.asv: He that tilleth his land shall have plenty of bread; But he that followeth after vain persons shall have poverty enough.
